ASI Suspended for Allegedly Planting Drugs on Sena Leader; SIT Formed

An Assistant Sub-Inspector (ASI) in Khanna, Punjab, has been suspended and a Special Investigation Team (SIT) formed after the ASI was allegedly caught on camera planting heroin at the residence of a Shiv Sena leader. The incident involved the alleged planting of drugs at the leader's house.
